overview: This Senate resolution fills in open majority-party seats on four Senate committees for the current Congress by adding Senator Justice to the Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry Committee; the Energy and Natural Resources Committee; the Special Committee on Aging; and the Small Business and Entrepreneurship Committee. Those seats had been left blank in the committee roster approved a week earlier. Committees are where most bills are first reviewed and changed. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on January 14, 2025.
for: Supporters say it completes committee rosters so a newly seated senator can take part in the committees' work.
against: Critics say the resolution is routine housekeeping that does not change any law or policy.
